import pandas as pd

# Extract the starting year from "years for jazz" (e.g., "2007", "1996 - 99")
start_years = pd.to_numeric(
    df["years for jazz"].astype(str).str.extract(r"(\d{4})")[0],
    errors="coerce",
)

# US players who started after 1985
us_after = df[
    (df["nationality"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "united states")
    & (start_years > 1985)
]

count_ok = len(us_after) == 4

# The most recent (max start year) player must be louis amundson
us_start = start_years[us_after.index]
most_recent_idx = us_start.idxmax()
most_recent_player = df.loc[most_recent_idx, "player"].astype(str).strip().lower()
recent_ok = most_recent_player == "louis amundson"

answer = bool(count_ok and recent_ok)
